modules.name: Gekokujo
modules.author: Marty Olson (marty4286)
modules.summary: Total conversion set in Sengoku-era Japan.
modules.description:
Gekokujo takes Warband to Sengoku-era Japan: clans fight for the country with ashigaru and samurai, bows and guns, and lords carry their historical banners.

Version 3.0 adds an opening mission, freelancing with promotion from ashigaru to samurai, agents (ninja) that open castle walls, basic battle formations for the AI, sea routes with sea battles, forts with free storage and recruits, and a detailed map from Kyushu to Ezo with Ikko temple fortresses. Weapons, armour, clothing, music and scenes are new or reworked.

The mod is in English only: in other languages, text it did not translate shows Native's translation.

Many unofficial versions exist, so names are confusing. This entry is the original.

Versions:
1. Original Gekokujo: the Japanese overhaul. Version 3.0 was finished in 2014; 3.1 was left as an unfinished beta. https://www.moddb.com/mods/gekokujo
2. Hatamoto Edition: adds roleplaying features: buying property, weapon customization, duels, character traits and other mechanics. Playable, development appears inactive. https://www.nexusmods.com/mbwarband/mods/6276
3. Daimyo Edition Reimagined: a branch of Daimyo Edition (new weapons, armour, animations and mechanics), adding more troops, combat improvements and visual changes. Playable, development appears inactive. https://www.moddb.com/mods/gekokujo-daimyo-edition-reimagined-submod
4. Hubii's Unofficial Gekokujo Patch: not a new version, but bug fixes and improvements for Hatamoto and Daimyo Reimagined. Still receiving updates in 2026. https://www.moddb.com/mods/unofficial-gekokujo-patch

Lineage: Original Gekokujo leads to Hatamoto Edition and Daimyo Edition, and Daimyo Edition leads to Daimyo Reimagined. Hubii's patch covers Hatamoto and Daimyo Reimagined.

Which should you play? More roleplaying, ownership and character mechanics: Hatamoto. More troops, weapons, battles and expanded content: Daimyo Reimagined. Fewer bugs: install Hubii's matching patch on whichever version you choose.
modules.notes: Apply the World map patch from the module's Patches window.

modules.name: Persistent World
modules.author: Vornne
modules.summary: Multiplayer role-play: factions, castles, crafting and trade.
modules.description:
Persistent World is a multiplayer-only role-playing module: players join factions, take castles, gather resources, craft and trade, and keep their money and gear on the server.

It joins servers that run the same version (4.5).
modules.notes: Basic support: joining and playing on servers works; controls for its action menus are still being refined.

ru.summary: Сетевая ролевая игра: фракции, замки, ремесло и торговля.

modules.name: 1860s Old America
modules.author: Gabrilduro
modules.summary: The American Civil War and the Wild West.
modules.description:
1860s Old America takes Warband to North America in the 1860s: the American Civil War, the western frontier, the French intervention in Mexico and the Indian Wars. It is a single-player role-playing and strategy campaign, played in first or third person.

The map runs from the Civil War battlefields of the east across the West to Mexico. Factions include the armies of the Civil War, France with its own lords, towns and troops in Mexico, Mexican and Comanchero bands, and the Apaches and other Indian nations. Western towns and Indian camps have their own scenes, and showdowns with gunfights take the place of arenas.

It adds revolvers, rifles, uniforms, outfits and fully equipped horses, new troop trees and faces, companions and merchants, battle formations and orders, and music that follows the faction and the situation.

The original also offers custom battles and LAN multiplayer, including co-op, with ten playable factions.
modules.notes: Apply the battle consequences patch from the module's Patches window. Notices that the multiplayer-only factions were eliminated appear at the start of a new game; this is the module's own behaviour.

ru.summary: Гражданская война в США и Дикий Запад.

modules.name: 1257AD - Enhanced Edition
modules.author: DrTomas, obamaladen
modules.summary: A historically grounded campaign in 13th-century Europe, starting in 1257 AD.
modules.description: Anno Domini 1257 recreates 13th-century Europe, starting in 1257 AD and aiming to be as historically accurate as possible. From that point, the player and NPC lords shape the land and fight for supremacy and control of the continent.

modules.id: A World of Ice and Fire
modules.name: A World of Ice and Fire
modules.author: produno
modules.summary: A single-player Game of Thrones overhaul set across Westeros and Essos.
modules.description: A World of Ice and Fire is a single-player Game of Thrones overhaul mod for Mount & Blade: Warband, created by produno and originally released in 2017. Set across Westeros and Essos, it lets players create their own house, navigate political treachery, and fight to claim the Iron Throne.

modules.id: The Last Days of the Third Age
modules.name: The Last Days of the Third Age
modules.author: TLD community
modules.summary: A Tolkien-based Warband overhaul with 19 factions and a winnable campaign.
modules.description: The Last Days of the Third Age is a long-standing, community-developed Tolkien-based mod for Mount & Blade: Warband. Play as the Free Peoples or Sauron's forces across 19 lore-accurate factions, as Men, Elves, Dwarves, Orcs, or Uruk-hai, each with distinct appearances and gear restrictions. Traditional money is replaced by faction-specific resource points and influence earned through quests, battles, and scrap loot. Factions have dynamic strength and localized standings, and capitals and settlements can be razed to eliminate factions and win the war. The mod features custom armor, weapons, locations, companions, NPCs, and an original orchestral soundtrack.

modules.name: Rome at War
modules.author: Seek n Destroy, Rome at War development team
modules.summary: Total conversion set in 300 B.C., after Alexander the Great.
modules.description: Rome at War is a total conversion set in 300 B.C., 23 years after the death of Alexander the Great. It supports single-player and multiplayer, and needs Warband 1.161 or later.
modules.notes: Basic support: the single-player campaign runs; multiplayer and the rest of the mod have not been fully tested yet.

ru.summary: Глобальная модификация: 300 год до н. э., после Александра Македонского.
